scope: Slipstream Labor Deep Dive — schedule templates by demand tier (Downtown, Studio, 1899 Penn; NMWA for completeness)

rules_sep5.open_close: Downtown & Studio: 2 people open-to-close — kitchen 45 min before open, barista/lead 30 min before, two closers to 30 min after close
rules_sep5.studio_midday: Studio Mon–Thu: 3 people 8:00–12:30 (opener leaves 12:30, third arrives 8:00); slow months: 2 core + admin on admin days
rules_sep5.managed: 1899 and NMWA may stagger / go solo in slow months
rules_sep5.sl_max: 9 h (10 h open-to-close lead allowed on 9-hour+ days as the cheapest way to meet two closers)

changes_from_v1_1: Floors rebuilt to the Sep 5 rules; 6-hour minimum shifts; planning rates = Aug 2026 roster averages by role ($22.25 SL / $19.75 PL / $20.25 PB / $20.00 barista & closer)
Admin-day sets: on Gee/Colin/Eli/Claire days the slow-tier template drops one core body inside the admin window
Projections v1.8 checked against 2025 actuals and the Jul–Aug run-rate; Sep–Dec tiers re-stated on the run-rate case
Incentive: four options bench-tested (backtest Apr–Aug 2026 + 2027 simulation); target-based beat shares do not pay under the new rules — template-based ones do

definitions.core_labor: Square timecards excluding job titles 'Manager' (admin) and 'Training'; 'Event' excluded
definitions.wage_basis: gross guaranteed wages (Square hourly_rate × hours) as % of core (ex-catering) sales — the basis of the 30/32/35 targets
definitions.pl_bridge: P&L labor ≈ 1.12 × gross wages (core+admin+training) − credit-card tips; validated Apr–Aug 2026 within 0.4–2.3% per cafe
definitions.capacity: planning capacity per cafe = busy-hour p90 throughput observed: Downtown 14, Studio 12, 1899 14 transactions per person-hour
definitions.need_rule: need(h) = max(floor, ceil(txns/h ÷ capacity)); floors — Downtown: 1 at 6:00, 2 from 6:30 to 1:00p, then 1; Studio: 1 at 6:00 (7:00 weekend), 2 to 90 min before close, then 1, Monday 3 from open to 10:00; 1899: 1 (lead) throughout, 2 in the 8–10a and 12:30–2p peaks when the curve is >= 12/hr; NMWA 1 (2 on community days)
definitions.optimizer: per cafe × tier × DOW integer program: Production Line opens (6–8 h), Shift Lead opens (8–9 h), optional Closer (4–8 h, keyholder), up to three 4–8 h barista shifts; 1899: lead 6:30–3:30 + one or two 4–8 h Production Barista shifts, max 2 on the floor; keyholder on the floor open−30 min to close+tail; minimise wages at standard rates

Dec.ryan_override: slow (holiday weeks Dec 21–Jan 3 slow; Dec 1–18 may run mid)
slow (holiday weeks Dec 21–Jan 3 slow; Dec 1–18 may run mid)
slow (holiday weeks Dec 21–Jan 3 slow; Dec 1–18 may run mid)

tier_band_validation.note: k-means (k=3) and Jenks breaks on the 33–34 weekly 2026 observations per cafe

1899 Penn.comment: 1899 is still growing ~90% YoY so absolute bands mix ramp with season; kept at 3,300/4,200 because Sep–Dec projections fall in the mid band

definitions.opt1: Open-cafe pool — DT+Studio beat share 50%, cap 1.5% of DT+Studio sales; all core hours share
definitions.opt2: Own-metric pool — Option 1 + 1899 adds $200 when NI ≥ 5% of sales + NMWA adds $100 when at/under staffing-rule hours
definitions.opt3: Template beat — 50% of Σ(template wages − actual core wages) over all cafes, cap 1.5% of all-cafe core sales
definitions.opt4: On-template + beat — $300/$300/$150/$75 per cafe-month at or under template (1% tolerance) + 50% of the beat, cap 1.5%
definitions.split: payout ÷ total core wages of all participants = bonus %; each person receives that % of own core wages

plans.A: Beat Share 50%, cap 1.5% of sales, pooled (recommended)
plans.A2: Beat Share 50%, paid only when ≥ 2 pts under target (Ryan's draft gate)
plans.A3: Beat Share 40%, cap 1.0% of sales, pooled (leaner sibling of A)
plans.B: Dollar-an-hour: $1.00 / $1.50 / $2.00 per core hour at ≤ target / −2 / −4 pts
plans.C: Gainshare 20% of the beat, no gate, no cap
plans.D: $8 per shift in every WEEK that hits target (weekly, no cap)
plans.E: Prime-cost gainshare: 50% of (prime target − actual prime) × sales, cap 2% of sales
plans.F: Beat Share 50%, cap 1.5%, PER-CAFE pools (no pooling across cafes)
plans.G: Quarterly Beat Share 50%, cap 1.5%, pooled — settled every 3 months

mixed_example.description: Studio 3 pts under, Downtown at target, 1899 2 pts over (mid month)

annual_simulation.model: 12-month 2027 calendar by tier; sales noise ±6%; realised core % = template % at current rates + 0.5 pt drift ± 1.5 pts (sd)

profit_share_sizing.note: Calendar = 2027 tier calendar above; cafe NOI at exactly-target core wages with Apr–Aug COGS and opex; support burden = Apr–Jul average of Commissary+SRP+Cafe Mgmt+Central. NMWA excluded.

data_notes.projections_file: Projections/2026 Projections v1.8.xlsx (monthly summary identical to v1.7)
data_notes.optimizer: PuLP 3.3 / CBC; scripts ldd_10_need_v11.py, ldd_11_optimize_templates.py, ldd_12_incentive_v11.py
